name: monicas-interiors
description: Monica's Interiors: React + Vite + Tailwind + Framer Motion storefront with an Express + MongoDB + JWT API

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run db -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w apps/api
